steps.why: One product picture so the jar, wax and wick stay identical across shots.

params.prompt_or_change: Slow, gentle push-in toward the candle; the flame flickers softly in warm evening light; the jar stays exactly the same.
Very slow sideways drift past the candle, warm reflections sliding across the clear glass, soft flame flicker; the jar stays exactly the same.
Slow, gentle pull-back from the glowing candle, settling into a calm closing frame; soft flame flicker; the jar stays exactly the same.
Soft, warm solo piano, sparse and slow, calm evening mood, gentle resolved ending; instrumental only, no vocals, no humming, no speech.
The three shots in order, 5 s each, piano underneath at full level, fading out at the end.

steps.why: Code: exact order, length and aspect.
Exact closing line to the end, by code.

fix: Grader: stop treating the transcriber's output as proof of speech. gpt-4o-transcribe returns short random-language fragments on instrumental music ('여름이야기' here, '끄덕끄덕' and 'Dieu, tu es grand' on D20a, 'Sustantivo femenino.' on -91 dB silence in H41c). Before telling the judge 'speech heard', require a voice-activity/vocal detector (or a second transcription that agrees, with a prompt allowing an empty result), drop transcripts under ~5 words that are in a language other than the item's, and pass the result to the judge as 'possible speech (unverified)' rather than a fact.
evidence: candle_ad_final.mp4: 720x1280, 15.03 s, hard cuts at 5.03 and 10.03 s; frames show the same clear straight-sided glass jar, ivory wax, one wick, no label, warm lamplight; 'A little evening calm' (0-5 s) and 'Find your glow' (10-15 s) exact at the top. shot_1-3.mp4 have no audio stream, so the only sound is soft_piano.mp3 (15 s PCM, mixed at full level; final peak -0.8 dB). The judge's sole failing point was the transcript '여름이야기' ('summer story'), a hallucination on instrumental audio.
